customManagers.description: rulesync: one exact version in the workflows, the justfile and the docs that show the command
actionlint: the checksum-pinned release binary in the workflows, and the justfile's mise pin
gitleaks: the checksum-pinned release binary in the workflows, and the justfile's mise pin
ruff: the checksum-pinned release binary in lint.yml, and the justfile's uvx/mise pin

packageRules.description: rulesync ships a major almost daily. Wait a week and batch weekly. Consumers run reusable-sync-ai-rules.yml at @main, so a merged bump reaches every caller: lint.yml's generate --check guards this repo's copies, and its 'Consumer sync path' step guards the callers' config-less fetch + generate.
prBodyNotes: Consumers run `reusable-sync-ai-rules.yml` at `@main`, so this bump reaches every caller on merge. Lint's `Consumer sync path (fetch + generate)` step runs that workflow's fetch, verify and generate steps with the new version against this repo's default branch; it must be green, not only `generate --check`. It does not cover caller-specific inputs such as a narrower `targets`.

Renovate cannot recompute the release checksum. Update `ACTIONLINT_SHA256` in every workflow that sets `ACTIONLINT_VERSION` by hand: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v{{{newVersion}}}/actionlint_{{{newVersion}}}_linux_amd64.tar.gz | sha256sum`. Until then the `sha256sum -c` step fails, so this PR stays red (fails closed).

Renovate cannot recompute the release checksum. Update `GITLEAKS_SHA256` in every workflow that sets `GITLEAKS_VERSION` by hand: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v{{{newVersion}}}/gitleaks_{{{newVersion}}}_linux_x64.tar.gz | sha256sum`. Until then the `sha256sum -c` step fails, so this PR stays red (fails closed).

packageRules.description: ruff must match the version FVH consumers run over their trees (the formatter's Markdown output changes between versions), so a bump is approved deliberately from the dependency dashboard.
prBodyNotes: Renovate cannot recompute the release checksum. Update `RUFF_SHA256` in .github/workflows/lint.yml by hand: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/download/{{{newVersion}}}/ruff-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | sha256sum`. Until then the `sha256sum -c` step fails, so this PR stays red (fails closed).
